concerns.text: The plan excludes REML convergence‑failure replicates from the coverage calculation (FR‑006). Since failures are more likely when heterogeneity is high or the estimator is unstable, this selective exclusion makes the coverage outcome dependent on the estimator’s performance, introducing selection bias and inflating reported coverage rates. The validation target (coverage) is no longer independent of the predictor (REML estimator), violating methodological soundness.
